description: This file contains unit tests for a hash table implementation, including class definitions, test cases for insertion, deletion, copying, moving, iteration, and internal management of ownership of pointer-based nodes.

classes.name: Int
classes.description: A wrapper class for integers that tracks creation and destruction counts.

classes.name: TestHashNode
classes.description: A node structure for the hash table containing a pointer to an Int and methods for state checks.

classes.name: TestHashTable
classes.description: A hash table class derived from HashTableBase, managing ownership of Int pointers, with methods for insertion, removal, lookup, and iteration.

methods.name: Int::ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets global counters for creation and destruction of Int objects.

methods.name: TestHashTable::contains
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the hash table.

methods.name: TestHashTable::insert
methods.description: Inserts a value into the hash table.

methods.name: TestHashTable::erase
methods.description: Removes a value from the hash table.

methods.name: TestHashTable::clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the hash table.
